description: Merge recipes (each at its own servings) and anything else into one shopping list by aisle, in what a store sells (10 cloves garlic → 1 head). Use for "make me a list", "what do I need to buy?" or "add paper towels and 2 lb bananas" (extra_items keep the cook's amounts). What the cook has stays off (left_off); staples and small amounts of bulk items (3 tbsp flour) come back as likely_have, not bought: ask which they have or are out of, then update_shopping_list. Items that hit their allergies are flagged. Signed in, the list is saved and returns a shareable url and an id for order_groceries; signed out it comes back unsaved (keep: true asks them to sign in).

extra_items.description: Anything else for the same trip, as the cook said it, amount included: ["paper towels", "2 lb bananas"]. A matching recipe ingredient gets that quantity added when the units agree, or both amounts when they don't.

include_staples.description: Put salt, oil, sugar, etc. on the list instead of the pantry check

keep.description: Save the list to the cook's kitchen. Signed in it is always saved; signed out, keep: true asks the cook to sign in first

pantry.description: Ingredients the cook already has, e.g. ["flour", "eggs"]

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

name: build_shopping_list

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

buy.description: What to buy at the store, e.g. "1 head"; null when need is enough

buyCount.description: How many to put in a cart: packages of buy, or whole items for a counted ingredient

extra.description: Amounts shown beside the main one (a unit that could not be added)

flag.description: "Contains milk" when it hits the cook's allergies

fromRecipes.description: Slugs of the recipes that use it; empty for an extra the cook added

inPantry.description: On the check-the-pantry side: the cook has it or it's a staple

need.description: What the recipes call for, e.g. "10 cloves"

why.description: On likely_have lines: a staple, or a small amount of a shelf-stable bulk item

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

cost_estimate.description: What the list costs at the store in whole packages (#245), an estimate

as_of.description: The month the prices are for ("2026-09"); null when nothing was priced

basis.description: store: the cook's own store quoted every priced line; reference: national average prices (BLS, USDA ERS)

line.description: "About $8.40 for 4 servings ($2.10 each). National average prices." An estimate, never a quote; never name a store or brand

missing.description: Lines left out of the total

partial.description: True when a line couldn't be priced: the total leaves it out. Name what's missing whenever you give a figure

seasonings_not_counted.description: Unpriced staples and dried spices, a pinch from the pantry: left out without making it partial

id.description: The saved list's id, for order_groceries (signed in only)

left_off.description: How many lines were left off because the cook has them: "left off 6 you have"

likely_have.description: Staples and small amounts of bulk items (3 tbsp flour, 4 tbsp wine) the cook probably has: set aside instead of a full-size purchase, not counted in the cost. Ask which they do need (they move to the aisles) and which they have (they come off) with update_shopping_list; absent on lists saved before this
